recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If FHIR-32577 is reviewed independently, assess any remaining wording details for the referenced-item-category rename there; no FHIR-11907 source correction is needed in this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-11907 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 and asked to replace the invalid LP-code CLD list used by Composition.class with the value set used by DocumentReference.class, rename c80-doc-classcodes to document-classcodes, and remove the HITSP C80 reproduction text.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn 14517, represented in git by 68a11fd7f788b9d67f05aca68d9ecd08236580ca. That commit changed Composition's binding from valueset-doc-categorycodes to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/document-classcodes, changed DocumentReference's spreadsheet reference from valueset-c80-doc-classcodes to valueset-document-classcodes, renamed the value set source file, and removed the HITSP C80 reproduction wording.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini maps the old R3 names Composition.class and DocumentReference.class to Composition.category and DocumentReference.category. Both current authoritative elements bind to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/referenced-item-category. FHIR-32577, a later Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 issue, explains this rename from document-classcodes to referenced-item-category because DocumentReference can reference more than documents. The remaining source/composition/valueset-doc-categorycodes.xml file still contains LP codes, but source searches found no active current references to doc-categorycodes or document-classcodes.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Composition and DocumentReference category bindings remain aligned and point to the later renamed referenced-item-category value set, so changing the unreferenced legacy LP-code file would not alter the current build behavior for FHIR-11907.
